_comment: Test-only content, written in our own words for MeuRPG's tests. The Sage is not in the SRD 5.1, so no book text may appear here (ADR-0008). It has only the mechanical fields: two skills, two languages to choose, and a feature shown as a note.

feature.name: Library Contacts
desc: Test text written for MeuRPG: years among books taught this character where knowledge is kept. When they do not know something, they can usually name a library, a scholar or an archive that might.

background-feature:library-contacts@test.text_pt: Contatos na biblioteca: quando não sabe algo, costuma saber onde ou com quem descobrir.
